name: F5 two simultaneous same-direction pairs on parallel tracks
why: Two pairs are booked at the SAME second in the same direction on one modelled track: the Bern platform throat 192191..91579 (IR/IR17 vs IC6, 0-1 s headway, 243 m) and Aarburg 86008..86152 (IC5 vs IC8, 5-8 s, 1 129 m). Neither headway is possible on one track; the trains must use parallel throat/line tracks. The run is copied for one line of each pair (9/18 m offset).
